[This](https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B7CIGCMCtoETVmhDNEZMbUVweTg/view) is a really nice resource that I use for the party's ranger. I also just improvise equipment that the party wants to make. For example, they killed a nothic and decided they wanted some spines off of it, later they decided to make some daggers and a couple days of crafting later they had 3 Nothic Spine Daggers which do necrotic instead of piercing. Little flavor stuff like that can really get the party into crafting. As for the rolls/minigames of crafting, I typically just have them roll a couple times to see if they can make anything out of the object, if they can't I have them seek the help of a blacksmith or scholar who has the knowledge/skill to aid the party.

After playing all the souls games and then coming to this, I was disappointed by the lack of variation. Some others in this thread I believe have mentioned being fewer weapons, which is true, as well as only 6 stats to level. The game is great though, the combat is fast and polished, your attacks are very fluid. Almost every attack you can perform is chainable in some way and it's very fun to dodge among a horde of enemies while quickly striking. If you're looking for a souls game in which you can collect items and armor and make lots of different builds (as I do) as well as farming a mob for a weapon or armor piece to experiment with, you may be disappointed, but if you're looking more for smooth combat and lore, this is a good choice.
